blocks.text: South Sudan has scheduled a general election for December 22, the first since the country gained independence from Sudan in 2011. But, as preparations lag, political tensions are high and the debate has intensified since President Salva Kiir dissolved the transitional unity government on September 22 to form a caretaker administration. Denis Logonyi, a journalist
